verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Cloud Backup feature that stores account data in a Microsoft personal account or iCloud. Nothing in the pack says those backups are end-to-end encrypted, that keys are held only by the user, or that an encryption design is published. Backup existence alone is adjacent to this story and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, backups are end-to-end encrypted with a key the vendor never holds, and the encryption design is documented
